hooks.name: Check resident messages
hooks.description: Every message template and the message composer must pass the length, clarity and feasibility checks.

hooks.name: Privacy guard on writes
hooks.description: Before the agent writes a file, remind it of the privacy rules so no real personal data lands in fixtures, logs or demos.

action.prompt: Before writing: confirm this change follows .kiro/steering/privacy-and-messages.md. Fixtures and demo data must be synthetic. No field may store a medical reason for a trip. Log statements may include ids, counts and timings only, never names, addresses or destinations. If the write would break any of these, change it first.
